verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows a direct probe for an OpenAPI/Swagger spec at all standard locations (openapi.json, swagger.json, etc.) returning 404 across the board, and no other citation surfaces a downloadable machine-readable API spec for the Agentic Commerce endpoints. While Stripe ships llms.txt, a skills.json index, and an MCP server, none of these constitute a downloadable OpenAPI/equivalent spec for the story as written.
